facts.fact: Vice President Bawumia opened Onix Accra 1 (12MW, Amrahia, Adentan, Greater Accra), a carrier-neutral co-location data center built by Onix and owned by African Infrastructure Investment Managers; the date is the article's, which gives no other.
Onix Accra 1 is described as the only Uptime Institute-certified Tier IV data center in Ghana (certification type not stated); article dated 2022-06-24.
